title: talentframe
summary: Program.Talents.cs is a full talent window: 384x512 chassis with the four-piece shell art, per-tab class background tiles (MageFire etc.), 3 tree tabs (VanillaTab), scrolled 296x332 grid with wheel + real scrollbar (arrows/knob/track drag), talent buttons with EmptySlot backdrop / icon grey-out / RankBorder + rank text with maxed-gold coloring, prerequisite link lines colored by met/unmet, points-remaining display, eligibility law (tier 5-per-row gating, prerequisite rank, required spell, free points), CMSG_LEARN_TALENT send with server confirm observation, talent-wipe cost display + Unlearn Talents confirm, Close + minimize close button, player portrait. TalentCatalog decodes Talent/TalentTab DBC.
